verdict.rationale: Bland's docs show API endpoints for creating pathways/agents, CLI and MCP server for managing agents, phone numbers, and placing calls, and Twilio number import — covering most of the pipeline across API, CLI, and MCP without dashboard use. However, there's no single documented end-to-end walkthrough showing agent creation → number attachment → call placement in one flow, and number provisioning is only shown via importing an existing Twilio number rather than a native 'buy a number' API call. Missing for 10: an explicit end-to-end tutorial/example chaining create-agent→attach-number→place-call, and native number provisioning via API/CLI (not just Twilio BYO).
